title: Traffic Light (VisualElements)

scenarios.title: Traffic Light applies its documented behavior
scenarios.expected: Traffic Light (BtnTrafficLight) is invoked on the documented fixture deck and produces its documented effect on the selection or presentation, leaves no new entry in %TEMP%\oPenEfficiency\error_YYYYMMDD.log and does not leave PowerPoint or the add-in in an unstable state.

scenarios.title: Traffic Light state codec validation is pinned host-free
scenarios.expected: The persistent state codec round-trips every field (state, H/V orientation, border flag, weight) and applies the historical strict validation: exact tag, integer state, H or V, 0 or 1, weight above zero, legacy comma-decimal float accepted; the enum-range check stays in the feature's UI model.

scenarios.title: Traffic Light creates exactly one shape in real PowerPoint
scenarios.expected: In an isolated real PowerPoint host, the deployed Traffic Light default (green) command on an empty slide adds exactly one shape (measured shapeCountDelta=1), reports execution, writes no new entry in the oPenEfficiency error log of the run day, and leaves the host stable.
